physical.model: Numerical coherent SPM + linear numerical XPM
physical.snr_policy: Full-load central-channel estimate, independent of occupancy and wavelength ID
physical.resource_policy: Undirected shared resources; one continuous wavelength per admitted request
physical.traffic_policy: Static batch, no splitting, grooming, regeneration or departures

topology_name: Synthetic 3-by-4 grid mesh; no geographic interpretation
resource_scope: Remaining physical channels are unavailable to these requests; full-load noise is retained

traffic.type: Static batch without departures; offered load is total requested Gbit/s
traffic.pairing: Same OD sequence and arrival order for fixed/mixed counterparts; separate OD/rate RNG streams

timing: Per-instance construction + candidate generation + solve; excludes shared physics warmup and result audit; retried ILPs include initial run + restart time
limitations: Synthetic topology and static batch; blocking fractions are not steady-state probabilities
ILP optimality is restricted to the K candidate routes and the fixed physical assumptions
Time-limited ILP incumbents are feasible benchmarks, not certified optima
Error bars are sample standard deviations across seeds, not confidence intervals
